title: Learning Monge maps with constrained drifting models
tldr_zh: 在OT映射凸锥内做KL约束梯度流，证明长时存在并维数无关指数收敛到Monge映射；参数化=自然梯度，玩具MMD 0.019 vs Adam 0.029
tldr_en: Constrained gradient flow of KL inside the convex cone of OT maps exists globally and converges to the Monge map at a dimension-free exponential rate; parameterized version is natural gradient descent (toy MMD 0.019 vs Adam 0.029).
key_numbers: Theorem 2.13(iii): lambda-convex D => ||T_t - T*||^2 <= (4/lambda) e^{-2 lambda t}(D(rho0)-D(gamma)), rate independent of d
Corollary 2.17: KL w.r.t. log-concave gamma (lambda=0): entropy O(1/t), map O(t^{-1/6}); lambda>0: both O(e^{-2 lambda t})

Toy 2D 4-mode GMM -> N(0,I), ICNN 2x20, 100 seeds, energy-distance MMD: explicit constrained 0.0194+-0.0098, implicit 0.0241+-0.0179, Euclidean GD 0.1213+-0.1138, Euclidean+Adam 0.0291+-0.0156 (Figure 2)
